name: Dirt Bike
description: A motor vehicle operated on two wheels that isn't an autocycle, a motorcycle or a motorized bicycle, the category an off-road e-moto falls into. It must be titled but can't be registered for the road unless modified to meet every safety requirement.

restrictions.rule: Two wheels, without the equipment of a road motorcycle
No limit on motor power or speed
Must be titled, and is subject to motor vehicle sales tax
Can't be registered for highway use unless it's modified to meet all safety requirements and passes a safety inspection
At the St. Joe State Park riding area: a park ORV permit, a DOT- or ANSI Z90.1-certified helmet on every rider, and direct supervision by a licensed adult for riders under 16 or unlicensed
